name: FaqWithImage
title: FAQ with illustration
description: A two-column FAQ section pairing an illustration with a separated accordion of questions and answers. Use when you want a friendlier, image-led FAQ on a content page.

i18nKeys.faqwithimage__q1: How can I reset my password?
i18nKeys.faqwithimage__a1: Head to your account settings and click 'Reset password'. We'll email you a secure link to choose a new one.
i18nKeys.faqwithimage__q2: Can I create more than one account?
i18nKeys.faqwithimage__a2: Yes — you can create as many accounts as you like, each with its own email address and settings.
i18nKeys.faqwithimage__q3: How can I subscribe to the monthly newsletter?
i18nKeys.faqwithimage__a3: Open your notification preferences and toggle on the monthly newsletter. You can unsubscribe at any time.
i18nKeys.faqwithimage__q4: Do you store credit card information securely?
i18nKeys.faqwithimage__a4: We never store raw card numbers. Payments are handled by a PCI-compliant processor and only a token is kept on our side.
